brief: Sixteen Goblins: 11 Legendary and 5 Rare, nine Attack, four Support and three Defense.

champions.name: Riffix, Brassstring Bard
champions.title: Brassstring Bard
champions.lore: Riffix rebuilt a shattered royal trumpet into the neck of his favorite lute. His battle hymns turn tavern quarrels into marching songs, and even the most exhausted raider finds another breath when the brass strings ring.
champions.gap: Goblins founding roster: 11 Legendary, 5 Rare; a personal 70% chance to resist newly applied Mana Slow or Mana Block from one member.

champions.name: Vexra, Velvet Knife
champions.title: Velvet Knife
champions.lore: Vexra learned to move between the lantern shadows of the glass-roofed city. Her velvet cloak conceals blades steeped in mooncap venom; by the time a guard hears the rain stop, she has already passed.

champions.name: Brondak, Ironhorn Rider
champions.title: Ironhorn Rider
champions.lore: Brondak rescued Ironhorn from a collapsed fighting pit and refused every offer to sell him. The armored rhinoceros now carries his rescuer into battle, breaking siege lines while smaller goblins shelter in their wake.

champions.name: Karvosh, the Greatblade
champions.title: the Greatblade
champions.lore: Karvosh forged his greatblade from the gate that once barred his clan from its own valley. He carries its enormous weight with a duelist’s precision, striking the weakest seam in every enemy rampart.

champions.name: Zizzara, Storm-in-Hand
champions.title: Storm-in-Hand
champions.lore: Zizzara caught her first lightning bolt in a copper cooking pot. Years later she no longer needs the pot: a whole storm circles in her palm, waiting for a name and a direction.

champions.name: Tickrul, Hourglass Heretic
champions.title: Hourglass Heretic
champions.lore: Tickrul stole a minute from the clock of a forgotten god and has spent his life paying it back. His hourglass lends precious seconds to wounded companions while fractured clocks hang motionless around him.

champions.name: King Grumvold
champions.title: King Grumvold
champions.lore: Grumvold claimed his crown by uniting feuding warrens rather than conquering them. His throne is built from the weapons surrendered that day, and every order he gives carries the weight of keeping that unlikely peace.

champions.name: Piknet, Reedpoint
champions.title: Reedpoint
champions.lore: Piknet knows which reeds bend under a hunting heron and which hide a goblin spear. Marsh raiders fear the silent ripple that precedes his attack more than any war horn.

champions.name: Rukko, Rustroad Captain
champions.title: Rustroad Captain
champions.lore: Rukko leads the Rustroad gang across ravines on engines assembled from wrecked siege machines. His chain-wrapped blade and roaring motorcycle turn a reckless charge into a carefully planned ambush.

champions.name: Nibsy, Hoodwink Scoundrel
champions.title: Hoodwink Scoundrel
champions.lore: Nibsy insists that every stolen purse is merely a loan from someone who will never miss it. Beneath the patchwork hood, a sharper mind watches for enchantments worth lifting along with the gold.

champions.name: Molgrik, Cinderfiend
champions.title: Cinderfiend
champions.lore: Molgrik survived a fall into the old furnace and returned with a heart of living magma. The warren calls him a demon, but he remembers every goblin who lowered a rope into the flames.

champions.name: Bubzle, Bottlebrewer
champions.title: Bottlebrewer
champions.lore: Bubzle brews remedies from ingredients that sensible healers refuse to touch. The bubbling pack on his back has saved more lives than any royal apothecary will admit, although its corks still require careful watching.

champions.name: Urdra, Gatebreaker
champions.title: Gatebreaker
champions.lore: Urdra’s shield was once the door of the last shelter standing after a siege. She carries it back to every threatened gate, refusing to let another clan learn how that night ended.

champions.name: Snaggle, Trapthorn
champions.title: Trapthorn
champions.lore: Snaggle lays traps to capture the beasts that would otherwise be hunted to extinction. His tusked companion tests every snare, and together they can turn an empty woodland path into an impassable maze.

champions.name: Morvessa, Moonbone Oracle
champions.title: Moonbone Oracle
champions.lore: Morvessa reads the phases of the moon in bones polished by underground rivers. Her blessings settle over travelers like a quiet dream, keeping hostile spells from finding a place to take root.

champions.name: Boltragg, Scrapwall
champions.title: Scrapwall
champions.lore: Boltragg builds walls from armor that other warriors have already broken. Every new dent tells him where to place the next rivet, and his companions have learned to trust the sound of his stubborn hammer.
